tokens.v: She wears only the reference knit on top - disregard the matte-black technical zip jacket and its reflective trim tape - over straight-leg charcoal wool trousers and black leather ankle boots. Catch her mid-pivot: ribbed hem and one sleeve swinging wide, hair lifted clear of the jaw, the rear boot sole off the ground. 28mm at f/4 from floor level, tilted up so she stands small under the towering field, upper third clear; the leading boot swings closest, soft, clipped by the bottom edge, her shadow raking out through the bottom-left corner.
